## 快速开始 ### 1. 启动守护进程并重启 Fcitx5 ```bash systemctl --user enable --now vinput-daemon.service fcitx5 -r ``` ### 2. 在 Fcitx5 中启用 打开 Fcitx5 配置 → 附加组件 → 找到 **Vinput** → 启用。 ### 3. 安装模型 打开 **Vinput GUI**（从应用菜单启动，或在终端运行 `vinput-gui`）。 进入 **资源 → 模型**，在可用模型列表中选择需要的模型，点击 **下载** 安装，然后点击 **使用** 激活。 也可以用 CLI： ```bash vinput model list -a # 浏览可用模型 vinput model add <模型名> # 下载并安装 vinput model use <模型名> # 设置为当前模型 ``` 也可手动将模型目录放到 `~/.local/share/vinput/models/<模型名>/`，目录内需包含： - `vinput-model.json` - `model.int8.onnx` 或 `model.onnx` - `tokens.txt` ### 4. 开始使用 - **短按** `Alt_R` 开始录音，再按一次停止并识别 - **长按** `Alt_R` 录音，松开自动识别上屏（push-to-talk） ## ASR 提供商 除了内置的本地模型，还可以安装云端 ASR 提供商，在速度、效果和成本之间灵活选择。 在 Vinput GUI 中进入 **资源 → ASR 提供商**，浏览可用提供商并点击 **安装**。或用 CLI： ```bash vinput provider list -a # 列出可用远程 ASR 提供商 vinput provider add # 从注册源安装 vinput provider use # 切换当前 ASR 提供商 ``` 随时按 `Shift_R` 打开命令面板，通过 `/asr`（`/a`）随时在运行时自由切换 ASR 提供商与模型。 当前可用的云端 ASR 提供商： | 提供商 | 模式 | 说明 | |--------|------|------| | 豆包（非流式） | 非流式 | 豆包语音 / 火山引擎录音文件极速版 | | ElevenLabs | 非流式 / 流式 | ElevenLabs speech-to-text API | | 阿里百炼 | 非流式 / 流式 | Qwen3-ASR，OpenAI 兼容 / Realtime API | | 豆包（流式） | 流式 | 火山引擎 AI Gateway Doubao ASR Realtime | | 豆包输入法（流式） | 流式 | 非官方豆包输入法实时语音识别协议 | | OpenAI 兼容 | 非流式 / 流式 | OpenAI `/v1/audio/transcriptions` 或 Realtime WebSocket | ## 按键说明 | 按键 | 默认 | 功能 | |------|------|------| | 触发键 | `Alt_R` | 短按切换录音；长按即说即停 | | 命令键 | `Control_R` | 选中文本后按住，语音指令修改选中内容 | | 命令面板键 | `Shift_R` | 打开统一命令面板（`/model` 指令模型、`/asr` ASR、`/scene` 场景、`/proc` 适配器） | | 翻页 | `Page Up` / `Page Down` | 候选列表翻页 | | 移动 | `↑` / `↓` | 候选列表移动光标 | | 确认 | `Enter` | 确认选中候选 | | 取消 | `Esc` | 关闭菜单 | | 快选 | `1`–`9` | 快速选择候选 | 所有按键均可在 Fcitx5 配置界面中自定义。 ## 配置文件位置 | 文件 | 路径 | |------|------| | Fcitx5 插件配置（按键等） | `~/.config/fcitx5/conf/vinput.conf` | | 核心配置（模型、LLM、场景） | `~/.config/vinput/config.json` | | 模型目录 | `~/.local/share/vinput/models/` | | ASR 提供商脚本 | `~/.local/share/vinput/providers/` | | LLM 适配器脚本 | `~/.local/share/vinput/adapters/` | Flatpak 安装下路径不同： | 文件 | 路径 | |------|------| | Fcitx5 插件配置 | `~/.var/app/org.fcitx.Fcitx5/config/fcitx5/conf/vinput.conf` | | 核心配置 | `~/.var/app/org.fcitx.Fcitx5/config/vinput/config.json` | | 模型目录 | `~/.var/app/org.fcitx.Fcitx5/data/vinput/models/` | | ASR 提供商脚本 | `~/.var/app/org.fcitx.Fcitx5/data/vinput/providers/` | | LLM 适配器脚本 | `~/.var/app/org.fcitx.Fcitx5/data/vinput/adapters/` |

# Claude Code Guide

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for full architecture, dual-planning model, compilation strategies, Issue+PR workflow, and hard constraints.

## Quick CLI Reference

- **Dual-Planning Model**:
  - *Phase A (Task Planning - BEFORE CODING)*:
    `gh issue view <id>` -> `git checkout -b <type>/issue-<id>-<desc>` -> `git commit --allow-empty -m "chore: init draft pr"` -> `git push -u origin <branch>` -> `gh pr create --draft --body "Closes #<id>\n\n### Tasks\n- [ ] 1. ..."`
  - *Phase B (Quality Gate Pre-check - AFTER EDIT)*: `mise run check:plan`
- **Execution Loop (ONE ITEM AT A TIME)**:
  - Code task N -> `mise run check:changed` (or `hk fix`) -> local atomic commit -> Repeat for all tasks
  - Structured fix stream: `hk run check --safe --format jsonl`
  - Finish: `git push origin <branch>` -> `gh pr edit --body` (update tasks to `- [x]`) -> `gh pr ready && gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch`
- **Quality Gate Tasks (`mise`)**:
  - `mise run check:changed`: Run safe check only on modified files
  - `mise run check:plan`: Preview execution plan without running tools
  - `mise run check:safe`: Run safe check across the repo
  - `mise run fix`: Auto-format all files
  - `mise run check`: Full repository validation
- **Compilation (Hardware-Adaptive)**:
  - *Modest Hardware (CI-First)*: `gh workflow run ci.yml && gh run watch`
  - *Pre-release Matrix Dry Build*: `gh workflow run release.yml && gh run watch`
  - *Local Incremental (Powerful hardware only)*: `mise run dev` -> `mise run build-debug`

## Hard Constraints (Red Lines)
- **No Direct Main Commits**: Always develop via feature branches and Draft PRs.
- **No Force-Push to Contributor Forks**: Never `git push -f` to external contributors' forks or branches. Ask them to rebase or handle conflicts within upstream branches only.
- **Pre-Commit Quality Gate**: Run `mise run check:changed` or `hk run check --safe` before pushing.
- **Hardware-Adaptive Compilation**: Prioritize GitHub Actions CI over heavy local builds on modest hardware.

## Ecosystem Repositories
- **Core Engine (C++20)**: [xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput](https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput) (`~/Code/fcitx5-vinput`)
- **Cloud ASR / LLM Scenes Registry**: [xifan2333/vinput-registry](https://github.com/xifan2333/vinput-registry) (`~/Code/vinput-registry`)
- **Arch AUR Packaging Automation**: [xifan2333/aur-auto](https://github.com/xifan2333/aur-auto) (`~/Code/aur-auto`)
- **Flatpak OSTree Repository Automation**: [xifan2333/flatpak-auto](https://github.com/xifan2333/flatpak-auto) (`~/Code/flatpak-auto`)

## Unified Project Skill
- **`vinput-dev`** (`.agents/skills/vinput-dev/SKILL.md`): Architecture, Dual-planning, Fork contribution, pre-PR code health-check, Issue+PR workflow, PipeWire debugging, ecosystem extension, release packaging.

title: ASR
description: "Speech recognition: local models, cloud providers, and hotwords."
---

## Concepts

ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) converts speech into text — the first step in the voice input pipeline.

```
Microphone → [ASR] → Raw text → (optional) Scene + LLM rewriting → Final text
```

Vinput provides three complementary ASR mechanisms:

- **Local models** — Offline recognition powered by [sherpa-onnx](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx). No network required, privacy-friendly, low latency.
- **Cloud providers** — Third-party ASR APIs (Doubao, Aliyun Bailian, ElevenLabs, OpenAI, etc.). Typically better accuracy, but requires network and API keys.
- **Hotwords** — Domain-specific vocabulary to improve recognition of proper nouns with local models (supported by some models).

Local models and cloud providers are **mutually exclusive** — switch between them at runtime with the `F8` menu. Hotwords take effect when a local model is active.

## Local models

### Concept

A local model is a set of sherpa-onnx compatible model files that run entirely offline. Each model has its own language, type, and size. Only one can be active at a time.

Corresponding config:

```json
{
  "asr": {
    "providers": [
      {
        "id": "sherpa-onnx",
        "type": "local",
        "model": "model.sherpa-onnx.sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue-int8",
        "timeout_ms": 15000
      }

title: 语音识别
description: 语音识别：本地模型、云端提供商与热词。
---

## 概念

ASR（Automatic Speech Recognition）负责将语音转换为文字，是整个语音输入流程的第一步。

```
麦克风 → [ASR] → 原始文本 → （可选）场景 + LLM 改写 → 最终文本
```

Vinput 提供三种互相配合的 ASR 机制：

- **本地模型** — 基于 [sherpa-onnx](https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx) 的离线识别，不依赖网络，隐私友好，延迟低
- **云端提供商** — 调用第三方云 ASR 接口（豆包、阿里百炼、ElevenLabs、OpenAI 等），识别效果通常更好，但需要网络和 API Key
- **热词** — 为本地模型补充领域特定词汇，提升专有名词的识别准确率（部分模型支持）

本地模型和云端提供商是**二选一**的关系，通过 `F8` 菜单在运行时随时切换。热词在本地模型激活时生效。

## 本地模型

### 概念

本地模型是一组 sherpa-onnx 兼容的模型文件，安装后完全离线运行。每个模型有自己的语言、类型和大小，一次只能激活一个。

# Issue + PR Driven Development Workflow (SOP)

Development must follow a strict, chronological **Pre-Code Draft PR -> Single-Item Loop -> Merge** process.

---

## 1. Dual-Planning Model

To avoid confusing functional planning with toolchain validation:

1. **Phase A: Task Planning (Pre-development - BEFORE CODING)**:
   - Defining *what* to build: Issue analysis, module boundaries, and opening the Draft PR with an unchecked `- [ ]` checklist.
2. **Phase B: Quality Gate Pre-check (Post-edit - AFTER EDIT)**:
   - Previewing *which* linter steps will execute on edited files via `mise run check:plan`.

---

## 2. Chronological Lifecycle

```
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Pre-Code Initialization (MANDATORY BEFORE ANY CODE IS WRITTEN)       |
|    gh issue view <id>                                                  |
|    git checkout -b <type>/issue-<id>-<name>                            |
|    git commit --allow-empty -m "chore: initialize draft pr for #<id>"   |
|    git push -u origin <type>/issue-<id>-<name>                         |
|    gh pr create --draft (ALL tasks unchecked: - [ ])                   |
+-----------------------------------+------------------------------------+
                                    |
                +-------------------v-------------------+
                | 2. Single-Item Focused Development    |
                |    Only implement the first - [ ]     |
                +-------------------+-------------------+
                                    |

                |    mise run check:plan (preview steps)|

F8 是旧版 **ASR Menu Keys** 的默认值，不是现在的命令面板键。现在默认是 **右 Shift**（`MenuKey` / `Shift_R`）。

**当前文档里的 F8（已改）：**

| 文件 | 原文 |
|---|---|
| `README.md` | switchable at runtime with `F8` |
| `README_zh.md` | `` `F8` 运行时切换 `` |
| `AGENTS.md` | hotkey triggers like `F8` |
| `site/.../docs/asr/index.md` | the `F8` menu |
| `site/.../docs/zh-cn/asr/index.md` | 通过 `F8` 菜单 |

都改成了右 Shift 命令面板 → `/asr`。快速上手指南本来就是 `Shift_R`，没动。

**故意没改：**

- `CHANGELOG.md`：当时确实是 F8，属于历史记录

# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in fcitx5-vinput!

## Documentation

Full documentation is available at the [project site](https://xifan2333.github.io/fcitx5-vinput/). For registry contribution guidelines (ASR providers, LLM adapters, models), see the [Registry](https://xifan2333.github.io/fcitx5-vinput/registry/) page.

## Build from Source

**Dependencies:** cmake, fcitx5, pipewire, libcurl, nlohmann-json, CLI11, Qt6

```bash
sudo bash scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh
cmake --preset release-clang-mold
cmake --build --preset release-clang-mold
sudo cmake --install build
```

Or use `mise`:

```bash
mise run sherpa
mise run configure-release
mise run build
sudo mise run install
```

## Project Structure

- `src/addon/` — Fcitx5 addon (key events, D-Bus client, UI)
- `src/daemon/` — ASR daemon (audio capture, inference, post-processing)
- `src/common/` — Shared code (configs, D-Bus interface, scenes)
- `src/cli/` — `vinput` CLI tool
- `site/` — Documentation site (Astro + Starlight)

## Submitting Changes

1. Fork the repo and create a branch from `main`
2. Make your changes — keep commits focused and atomic
3. Test locally: enable the addon in Fcitx5, verify the daemon works
4. Open a PR with a clear description of what and why

## Reporting Bugs

Use the [Bug Report](https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) template. Include:
- Version (`vinput --version`)
- Distribution
- Daemon logs: `journalctl --user -u vinput-daemon.service`

## Contributing to the Registry

The [vinput-registry](https://github.com/xifan2333/vinput-registry) repository hosts downloadable resources: ASR models, cloud ASR provider scripts, and LLM adapter scripts.

To contribute a new provider, adapter, or model, see the [Registry](https://xifan2333.github.io/fcitx5-vinput/registry/) page for the full specification.

Key rules:
- Scripts must be self-contained — standard library only, no third-party dependencies
- Python 3 is recommended; other runtimes are acceptable
- Each script resource needs an `entry.py` (or equivalent) and `README.md`
- Add i18n entries for both `en_US.json` and `zh_CN.json`

## Translations

Translation files are in `po/`. To add a new language:

1. Copy `po/fcitx5-vinput.pot` to `po/<lang>.po`
2. Fill in the translations
3. Submit a PR

## Code Style

- C++20
- Follow the existing style in the codebase

### Step 2.3: Staged Git Diff Audit (Cleanliness Checklist)
Run `git diff upstream/main --stat` and verify:
- [ ] No temporary files, build artifacts (`build/`), or editor files (`.vscode/`, `.idea/`).
- [ ] No hardcoded personal paths (e.g. `/home/username/...`).
- [ ] No accidentally committed secret tokens or API keys (`detect-private-key` in `hk` guards this).
- [ ] No merge conflict markers (`<<<<<<< HEAD`, `=======`).
- [ ] User-facing C++ strings are wrapped in `_("...")` for gettext localization.

## 3. Commit Message Hygiene (Conventional Commits)

Format: `<type>(<scope>): <concise imperative description> (#<issue_id>)`

- `feat`: New feature or enhancement (e.g. `feat(addon): add configurable indicator margin (#92)`)
- `fix`: Bug fix (e.g. `fix(daemon): handle PipeWire stream reconnection timeout (#88)`)
- `refactor`, `perf`, `docs`, `test`, `chore`

xgettext --keyword=_ --keyword=N_ --language=C++ --from-code=UTF-8 \
  --no-location --sort-by-file \
  -o - \
  $(find src/cli src/common src/addon src/daemon \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.h' \)) \
| msginit --locale=ja_JP --input=- --output=po/ja.po
```

Then add the new `.po` file to `po/CMakeLists.txt` and submit a PR.

content.text:
上游就是这么处理「修饰键当热键、同时还能打大写」的。核心在 `fcitx/fcitx5` 的 `instance.cpp`，不是 addon 自己发明一套。

### 关键 API

| API | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `KeyEvent::isRelease()` | 按下 / 松开 |
| `Key::isModifier()` | 是否纯修饰键（含 `Shift_R`） |
| `Key::isReleaseOfModifier(pressed)` | 这次松开是不是对应那次按下。松开时状态常是 `Shift+Shift_R`，不能用普通 `check()` |
| `keyEvent.filter()` | 输入法不再处理，**事件仍交给应用** |
| `keyEvent.filterAndAccept()` | 整键吃掉，应用收不到 |

`origKey().normalize()` 再拿去比，不要用已经 layout 转换过的 `key()`。

### 上游对修饰键热键的流程（中英切换同一套）

按下：

- 记下 `lastKeyPressed_`、`keyReleased_`
- **只 `filter()`，不 `accept()`**  
  注释原文：*don't forward to input method, but make it pass through to client*

松开：

- `origKey.isReleaseOfModifier(lastKeyPressed)` 才算配对
- 中间如果进过别的按键，`keyReleased_` 会被清掉 → 当成 combo，不触发热键（所以 Shift+A 只打大写）
- 还有 `ModifierOnlyKeyTimeout`（默认 250ms）：按太久再松，也不当热键，避免按住打一串大写松手却切了输入法
- 松开也是 **`filter()`，不 `accept()`**。完全吃掉 release 会让 Wayland 客户端误以为键还按着，甚至误触发重复

非修饰键（比如 F8）才是按下立刻 `filterAndAccept()` 并触发。

### 我们现在错在哪

对，不是同一套。上游也是 **KeyList 管按下，单 Key 管松开**。

`menu_keys_` 是 `fcitx::KeyList`。相关 API：

| API | 参数 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `check(Key)` | 单个 `Key` | 这次事件是不是这个键 |
| `checkKeyList(KeyList)` | 列表 | 内部对每个键调 `check()` |
| `keyListIndex(KeyList)` | 列表 | 命中了列表第几个，没有则 `-1` |
| `isReleaseOfModifier(Key)` | **只能是单个 Key** | 这次松开是不是那次按下的修饰键 |

没有 `isReleaseOfModifier` 的 KeyList 版本。松开时状态经常是 `Shift+Shift_R`，用 `checkKeyList(menu_keys_)` 会对不上。

上游 `instance.cpp` 就是拆开用的：

**按下**（KeyList）：

```cpp
auto keyIdx = origKey.keyListIndex(keyHandler.list);
if (keyIdx >= 0) {
    lastKeyPressed_ = origKey;  // 存的是单个 Key
}
```

**松开**（单 Key）：

```cpp
origKey.isReleaseOfModifier(lastKeyPressed)
```

我们这边应对齐成：

1. 按下：`origKey().normalize().keyListIndex(menu_keys_)` 判断是不是菜单键
2. 命中后把 **这一次的单个 Key** 存下来
3. 松开：`isReleaseOfModifier(存下来的那个 Key)`，不要对整个 `menu_keys_` 做 `checkKeyList`

const int trigger_index = keyEvent.key().keyListIndex(trigger_keys_);

isReleaseOfActiveTrigger(keyEvent.key())

content.text:
用默认右 Shift 时，实际手感是这样的：

**点一下右 Shift（按下后很快松开，中间没按别的键）**  
松开的那一下打开命令面板。再点一下同样方式关掉。

**按住右 Shift 打字**  
和以前系统 Shift 一样，用来打大写。例如按住右 Shift 再按 `a`，出来的是 `A`，**不会**弹出面板。松手也不弹。

**按住右 Shift 超过约 250ms 再松**  
即使中间没按别的键，也不开面板。避免你按住打大写、松手却突然弹出菜单。

**如果把菜单键改成普通键（比如 F8）**  
还是按下立刻开/关，和以前一样，没有“松开才触发”这一套。

和改之前的差别：以前右 Shift **一按下**就被输入法吃掉并开菜单，所以没法拿来打大写。现在按下会交给应用，只有“单独轻点”才在松开时开菜单。

content.thinking:
The user is asking about a specific configuration: what if the menu key is set to Ctrl+/ (Control+slash) rather than a modifier-only key like Shift_R. Would that work correctly with the current implem...Yes, that should work fine. Setting the menu key to Ctrl+/ is actually a pretty common pattern for chord hotkeys, and the current code handles it correctly.

The key difference is that Ctrl+/ is treated as a **non-modifier** key in the `isModifier()` check, so it takes the non-mod path: opens the palette on press and eats the entire key with `filterAndAccept()`. That’s exactly what you want — you don’t want the slash to be typed into the app, and you don’t want the palette to wait for release.

The only thing to watch out for is that the slash itself won t be typed, which is good. And since the key event has the Ctrl state, it will still match the `menu_keys_` list.

So yeah, Ctrl+/ is perfectly valid and should behave as expected.

content.text:
`Ctrl+/` 和单独的右 Shift 走的不是同一条路，但可以正常用。

`Ctrl+/` 的 **sym 是 `/`，不是修饰键**。`isModifier()` 为假，所以：

- **一按下 `/`（此时 Ctrl 已经按着）就开/关面板**
- 这次 `Ctrl+/` 会被吃掉，不会在输入框里打出 `/`
- 没有 250ms、也没有“松开才触发”

这是合理的：组合键本来就不该再交给应用。

对比一下：

| 菜单键 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 右 Shift / 左 Ctrl 这种**纯修饰键** | 轻点松开才开关面板；按住再按别的键当修饰键（大写、Ctrl+C） |
| `Ctrl+/`、F8 这种**带普通键的组合** | 按下立刻开关，并吞掉这次按键 |

需要避开的一种配法：菜单键如果和**命令键**配成同一个（默认命令键是右 Ctrl），语音命令会先抢走，面板热键根本进不去。`Ctrl+/` 和右 Ctrl 不是同一个键，没这个问题。

author:	xifan2333

--
Hi @changer-changer,

Thank you so much for the detailed report and the control experiment!

We investigated the issue under Ubuntu 22.04 (PipeWire 0.3.48 + WirePlumber 0.4.8):
1. **Root Cause**: `fcitx5-vinput` previously requested a 1-channel capture stream without specifying the channel position (`raw_info.position[0]` was uninitialized as `0` / `SPA_AUDIO_CHANNEL_UNKNOWN`, and `flags` lacked `SPA_AUDIO_FLAG_UNPOSITIONED`). On WirePlumber 0.4.8, when linking an ALSA hardware capture node with stereo channels (`[FL, FR]`) to an input stream with `UNKNOWN` channel position, WirePlumber's `si-standard-link` policy fails to find a channel mapping rule and silently refuses to establish the port links. Consequently, format negotiation succeeded (`rate=16000 channels=1 fmt=259`), but no audio data was ever routed into the stream.
2. **Fix**: In PR #170, we explicitly set `raw_info.position[0] = SPA_AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO` (following standard PipeWire `pw-cat` / `pw-record` conventions) and added `state_changed` listener callbacks to surface stream state transitions in the daemon log.

A test pre-release is now available: **[v2.3.19 (Pre-release)](https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput/releases/tag/v2.3.19)**.

Could you please test by updating to `fcitx5-vinput_2.3.19-1_debian12_amd64.deb` on your Ubuntu 22.04 system to see if recording now captures audio properly?

Looking forward to your feedback!

title:	Capture returns empty result on Ubuntu 22.04 (PipeWire 0.3.48): stream negotiates but no data

## Environment
- Ubuntu 22.04.5 (jammy), kernel 6.8, GNOME **Wayland**, fcitx5 5.0.14
- fcitx5-vinput **2.3.15** from `fcitx5-vinput_2.3.15-1_debian12_amd64.deb` (glibc 2.34 symbols — works on jammy's 2.35, all libs resolve)
- Audio: PipeWire 0.3.48 (jammy default) + pipewire-pulse 0.3.48, wireplumber 0.4.8

## Symptom
Recording starts/stops fine, ASR initializes, but `StopRecording` always returns `""` — no transcription, with any model (SenseVoice int8 / x-asr punct int8), VAD enabled or disabled.

## What I verified
- `vinput device list` was empty under plain PulseAudio (expected — PW had no audio nodes), so I switched the user session to pipewire-pulse + wireplumber.
- After the switch, `vinput device list` shows all sources; daemon log shows the stream comes up:
  ```
  vinput: using PipeWire target.object=alsa_input.pci-0000_00_1f.3-platform-skl_hda_dsp_6__source
  vinput: negotiated format: rate=16000 channels=1 fmt=259
  ```
- But the result is still empty, with VAD on and off, and with both the DMIC and the HDA analog source as `capture_device`.
- **Control experiment**: `pw-record --rate 16000 --channels 1` (pipewire-bin 0.3.48, same libpipewire the deb links) captures the same nodes fine — recording while playing a test wav gives −8 dB peaks; direct file transcription of that wav via sherpa-onnx gives correct text.
- The exact same hardware works perfectly with a sherpa-onnx Python pipeline (evdev F9 hold + pw-record), so the mic/loopback path is healthy.

## Conclusion
On PipeWire 0.3.48, vinput's capture stream negotiates but data never arrives (or arrives as silence) — something in the pw_stream usage is incompatible with 0.3.x. A version guard/warning for PipeWire < 1.0 would save other 22.04 users the debugging session 🙂

Happy to test a fix or provide more logs. Thanks for the great project!

content.text:
**在这台 Arch 本机上，复现不了。** 对方那条 bug 卡在很窄的组合上：

- Ubuntu 22.04 的 **PipeWire 0.3.48 + WirePlumber 0.4.8**
- **ALSA 立体声采集节点** `[FL, FR]`（他是 Intel SOF HDA DSP）
- 我们的流是 1ch，而且以前 `position` 是 `UNKNOWN`

WirePlumber 0.4.8 的 `si-standard-link` 对不上声道就**静默不连端口**：格式谈成功，数据永远是空的。`pw-record` 会设 `MONO`，所以对照实验能录到。

你这台是 **PW 1.6.8 + WP 0.5.15**，链接策略已经换代；本机还有立体声麦，但就算把 `MONO` 拿掉，0.5 多半照样能链上。Docker 也用不上（不在 `docker` 组，sudo 要密码）。

之前 GHA / bwrap 失败也是同一个原因：Azure 内核没有 `snd-dummy`，用户态 `audiotestsrc` **不会走 ALSA 那套声道映射**，所以假阳性「录得到」。

---

**不一定只能等对方真机**，但要自己证伪，得造出「22.04 + WP 0.4.8 + 立体声 ALSA 源」，不是再在 Arch 上拧 daemon。

可行的自己复现：

1. **用户态 QEMU Ubuntu 22.04**（`/dev/kvm` 是 `666`，不用 sudo）。虚拟机里装 jammy 的 pipewire/wireplumber，用 virtio/ICH9 HDA 当立体声采集，跑一个小 `pw_stream`：不设 MONO vs 设 MONO。
2. 再退一步：GHA `ubuntu-22.04` 里如果能搞出 **2ch ALSA 节点**（`snd-aloop` / 有 dummy 的 runner），比上次的 loopback 更接近。

**验证「2.3.19 修好了他的电脑」** 仍要等 `changer-changer`。issue 只有我们一条评论，对方还没回。那是确认修复，不是确认机制。

机制上我们自己可以用 VM 打一对：旧代码空数据、设了 `SPA_AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO` 有数据。要走这条的话可以说一声。
我觉得就是如果我们现在能够验证的话，我们自己就先验证，因为如果验证了，我们就可以发新版了。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "=== versions ==="
pipewire --version || true
wpctl --version || true
dpkg -l pipewire wireplumber libpipewire-0.3-0 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ii/{print $1,$2,$3}' || true

echo "=== kernel modules ==="
uname -a
ls /lib/modules/"$(uname -r)"/kernel/sound/drivers/ 2>/dev/null || true
sudo modprobe snd-dummy 2>/dev/null || echo "snd-dummy: not loaded"
sudo modprobe snd-aloop 2>/dev/null || echo "snd-aloop: not loaded"
ls -l /dev/snd 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== start pipewire ==="
pipewire &
PIPEWIRE_PID=$!
pipewire-pulse &
PULSE_PID=$!
wireplumber &
WIREPLUMBER_PID=$!
sleep 2
pw-cli info 0 || {
  echo "PipeWire failed to start"
  exit 1
}

echo "=== nodes ==="
pw-dump | python3 - <<'PY' || true
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
for node in data:
    if node.get("type") != "PipeWire:Interface:Node":
        continue
    props = node.get("info", {}).get("props", {})
    media = props.get("media.class", "")
    if "Audio" not in media:
        continue
    print(f"{node.get('id')}\t{media}\t{props.get('node.name')}\tpos={props.get('audio.position')}")
PY

gcc -O2 -o /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture scripts/repro-issue-169-capture.c \
  $(pkg-config --cflags --libs libpipewire-0.3) -pthread

ffmpeg -nostdin -y -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration=8 -ac 2 /tmp/sine.wav >/tmp/ffmpeg.log 2>&1
pw-cat --playback --rate 48000 --channels 2 /tmp/sine.wav >/tmp/pw-cat.log 2>&1 &
PLAY_PID=$!
sleep 1

MONITOR=$(pw-dump | python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
for node in data:
    if node.get("type") != "PipeWire:Interface:Node":
        continue
    props = node.get("info", {}).get("props", {})
    name = props.get("node.name", "")
    media = props.get("media.class", "")
    if media == "Audio/Source" or name.endswith(".monitor"):
        print(name)
        break
PY
)
echo "capture target: ${MONITOR:-default}"

echo "=== UNKNOWN position ==="
if [[ -n "${MONITOR}" ]]; then
  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture unknown "${MONITOR}" | tee /tmp/unknown.out
else
  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture unknown | tee /tmp/unknown.out
fi

echo "=== MONO position ==="
if [[ -n "${MONITOR}" ]]; then
  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture mono "${MONITOR}" | tee /tmp/mono.out
else
  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture mono | tee /tmp/mono.out
fi

echo "=== pw-link ==="
pw-link -l || true

kill "${PLAY_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
kill "${WIREPLUMBER_PID}" "${PULSE_PID}" "${PIPEWIRE_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== summary ==="
echo "unknown $(cat /tmp/unknown.out)"
echo "mono    $(cat /tmp/mono.out)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

list_audio_nodes() {
  pw-dump | python3 -c '
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
for node in data:
    if node.get("type") != "PipeWire:Interface:Node":
        continue
    props = node.get("info", {}).get("props", {})
    media = props.get("media.class", "")
    if "Audio" not in media:
        continue
    print(f"{node.get(\"id\")}\t{media}\t{props.get(\"node.name\")}\tpos={props.get(\"audio.position\")}")
'
}

first_source_name() {
  pw-dump | python3 -c '
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
for node in data:
    if node.get("type") != "PipeWire:Interface:Node":
        continue
    props = node.get("info", {}).get("props", {})
    media = props.get("media.class", "")
    name = props.get("node.name", "")
    if media == "Audio/Source" or str(name).endswith(".monitor"):
        print(name)
        break
'
}

echo "=== versions ==="
pipewire --version || true
dpkg -l pipewire wireplumber libpipewire-0.3-0 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ii/{print $1,$2,$3}' || true

echo "=== kernel modules ==="
uname -a
ls /lib/modules/"$(uname -r)"/kernel/sound/drivers/ 2>/dev/null || true
sudo modprobe snd-dummy 2>/dev/null || echo "snd-dummy: not loaded"
sudo modprobe snd-aloop 2>/dev/null || echo "snd-aloop: not loaded"
ls -l /dev/snd 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== start pipewire ==="
pipewire &
PIPEWIRE_PID=$!
pipewire-pulse &
PULSE_PID=$!
wireplumber &
WIREPLUMBER_PID=$!
sleep 2
pw-cli info 0

echo "=== nodes before playback ==="
list_audio_nodes || true

gcc -O2 -o /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture scripts/repro-issue-169-capture.c \

pw-cat --playback --rate 48000 --channels 2 /tmp/sine.wav >/tmp/pw-cat.log 2>&1 &
PLAY_PID=$!
sleep 1

echo "=== nodes during playback ==="
list_audio_nodes || true

MONITOR="$(first_source_name || true)"

  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture unknown "${MONITOR}" | tee /tmp/unknown.out

  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture unknown | tee /tmp/unknown.out
fi

  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture mono "${MONITOR}" | tee /tmp/mono.out
else
  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture mono | tee /tmp/mono.out
fi

echo "=== pw-link ==="
pw-link -l || true

kill "${PLAY_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
kill "${WIREPLUMBER_PID}" "${PULSE_PID}" "${PIPEWIRE_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== summary ==="

content.text: GHA 上版本对了，但没有任何采集节点，两边都是 `no node available`。接下来用用户态立体声 null sink 的 monitor 再跑一轮。

PULSE_PID=$!
wireplumber &
WIREPLUMBER_PID=$!
sleep 2
pw-cli info 0

echo "=== nodes before playback ==="
list_audio_nodes || true

gcc -O2 -o /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture scripts/repro-issue-169-capture.c \
  $(pkg-config --cflags --libs libpipewire-0.3) -pthread

ffmpeg -nostdin -y -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration=8 -ac 2 /tmp/sine.wav >/tmp/ffmpeg.log 2>&1
pw-cat --playback --rate 48000 --channels 2 /tmp/sine.wav >/tmp/pw-cat.log 2>&1 &
PLAY_PID=$!
sleep 1

echo "=== nodes during playback ==="
list_audio_nodes || true

MONITOR="$(first_source_name || true)"
echo "capture target: ${MONITOR:-default}"

echo "=== UNKNOWN position ==="
if [[ -n "${MONITOR}" ]]; then
  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture unknown "${MONITOR}" | tee /tmp/unknown.out
else
  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture unknown | tee /tmp/unknown.out
fi

echo "=== MONO position ==="
if [[ -n "${MONITOR}" ]]; then
  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture mono "${MONITOR}" | tee /tmp/mono.out
else
  /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture mono | tee /tmp/mono.out
fi

echo "=== pw-link ==="
pw-link -l || true

kill "${PLAY_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true
kill "${WIREPLUMBER_PID}" "${PULSE_PID}" "${PIPEWIRE_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=== summary ==="
echo "unknown $(cat /tmp/unknown.out)"
echo "mono    $(cat /tmp/mono.out)"

content.text:
自己跑过了，**还是不能当成「修好了」的证据，不能据此发正式版。**

在 GitHub 的 **Ubuntu 22.04** 上装了和对方一样的 **PipeWire 0.3.48 + WirePlumber 0.4.8**，对照实验：

| | UNKNOWN（旧代码） | MONO（2.3.19） |
|---|---|---|
| 流状态 | streaming | streaming |
| 收到数据 | 95516 bytes | 95516 bytes |
| 峰值 | 0（静音） | 0（静音） |

两边行为一样。原因还是缺那块硬件图：

- Azure 内核 **加载不了** `snd-dummy` / `snd-aloop`
- 用户态立体声 null sink 有 `[FL, FR]`，但走的不是 ALSA 的 `si-standard-link`
- 对方的空结果是 **SOF 立体声 ALSA 节点连不上**；GHA 上没有这个节点，链接策略根本没走到那条失败路径

所以：版本对齐了，**机制没复现**。2.3.19 的 MONO 修复仍然只是「和 `pw-record` 对齐」的合理补丁，不是我们在 22.04 真机上看到从空到有。

要自己证伪，只剩带 **HDA/SOF 立体声采集** 的 Ubuntu 22.04 虚拟机或等 `changer-changer` 回 v2.3.19。复现分支在 `ci/repro-issue-169`，不必合进 main。
但是最早我们的 debian12 好像是可以的，之前可能刚支持的时候，嗯，因为我记得当时有用户在用。

content.text:
可以测，但两条路差别很大：

**Distrobox 默认不行。** Ubuntu 22.04 容器会接着用你现在这台 Arch 的 PipeWire 1.6 + WirePlumber 0.5，等于没进 jammy。要在容器里再跑一套 0.3.48 + 0.4.8，还得跟宿主机抢 `/dev/snd`，桌面声音会乱。你本机已经有立体声 ALSA（`CX20590` `[FL, FR]`），这条理论上能打到真机路径，但要停掉宿主机 PipeWire，不适合当日常验证。

**QEMU 更合适。** 不映射宿主机麦克风。虚拟机里用模拟 **Intel HDA**，客人系统自己看到立体声 ALSA + jammy 的 WP 0.4.8，正好是对方那种「立体声 ALSA → 单声道流」的链接路径。`/dev/kvm` 已经是 `666`，装好 qemu 就能用用户权限跑，不用透传 USB。

本机现在没有 qemu / distrobox，Docker 也进不去（不在 `docker` 组）。需要你在本机执行一次（会要密码）：

```bash
sudo pacman -S --needed qemu-system-x86 qemu-img cloud-utils edk2-ovmf
```

装好之后我可以：下 jammy cloud 镜像 → cloud-init 装 pipewire 0.3.48 / wireplumber 0.4.8 → 用和 vinput 相同的 `pw_stream` 对照 UNKNOWN vs `SPA_AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO`。

映射宿主机麦不是必须的；要复现的是 **客人里的 HDA 立体声节点**，不是把 Arch 的麦塞进去。
我已经提权了，你可以用docker了

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

  libpipewire-0.3-dev gcc pkg-config ffmpeg python3 \
  dbus dbus-user-session alsa-utils >/tmp/apt.log

echo "=== versions ==="
pipewire --version
dpkg -l pipewire wireplumber libpipewire-0.3-0 | awk '/^ii/{print $1,$2,$3}'

echo "=== aloop ==="
modprobe snd-aloop
cat /proc/asound/cards
ls -l /dev/snd

echo "=== alsa loopback smoke ==="
ffmpeg -nostdin -y -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration=1 -ac 2 /tmp/sine-short.wav >/dev/null 2>&1
aplay -D hw:Loopback,0,0 -q /tmp/sine-short.wav &
arecord -D hw:Loopback,1,0 -f S16_LE -c 2 -r 48000 -d 1 /tmp/aloop.wav >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait || true
python3 - <<'PY'
import wave, sys
try:
    w = wave.open("/tmp/aloop.wav")
    frames = w.readframes(w.getnframes())
    peak = max(abs(int.from_bytes(frames[i:i+2], "little", signed=True)) for i in range(0, len(frames)-1, 2)) if frames else 0
    print("alsa_loopback_bytes", len(frames), "peak", peak)
except Exception as e:
    print("alsa_loopback_failed", e)
PY

gcc -O2 -o /tmp/repro-issue-169-capture /src/scripts/repro-issue-169-capture.c \
  $(pkg-config --cflags --libs libpipewire-0.3) -pthread

ffmpeg -nostdin -y -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000:duration=8 -ac 2 /tmp/sine.wav >/dev/null 2>&1

export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/pw-runtime
mkdir -p "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"
chmod 700 "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR"

dbus-run-session -- bash -s <<'EOF'
set -euo pipefail
pipewire &
sleep 0.4
pipewire-pulse &
wireplumber &
sleep 3
pw-cli info 0 >/dev/null

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
data = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["pw-dump"]))
print("=== nodes ===")
for node in data:
    if node.get("type") != "PipeWire:Interface:Node":
        continue
    props = node.get("info", {}).get("props", {})
    media = props.get("media.class", "")
    if "Audio" not in str(media):
        continue
    print(node.get("id"), media, props.get("node.name"), "pos=", props.get("audio.position"), "alsa=", props.get("api.alsa.path", ""))
PY

import json, subprocess
data = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["pw-dump"]))
for node in data:
    if node.get("type") != "PipeWire:Interface:Node":
        continue
    props = node.get("info", {}).get("props", {})
    name = str(props.get("node.name", ""))
    media = props.get("media.class", "")
    if media == "Audio/Sink" and "Loopback" in name:
        print(name)
        break
else:
    for node in data:
        if node.get("type") != "PipeWire:Interface:Node":
            continue
        props = node.get("info", {}).get("props", {})
        if props.get("media.class") == "Audio/Sink":
            print(props.get("node.name", ""))
            break
PY
)

import json, subprocess
data = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["pw-dump"]))
for node in data:

        continue
    props = node.get("info", {}).get("props", {})

if [[ -n "$SINK" ]]; then

The reporter's SOF sound card couldn't capture audio with vinput, but pw-record could, and our ThinkPad HDA worked even with UNKNOWN channel position. This is because SOF (Sound Open Firmware) nodes like `skl_hda_dsp_6__source` are special—they're not simple stereo cards like the CX20590. They often expose multiple ports (DMIC, HDMI, analog) with different channel maps, and WirePlumber's si-standard-link logic for SOF uses different session items than regular ALSA cards.

The key difference is that pw-record targets the node directly and negotiates format successfully, while vinput's channel position handling (UNKNOWN) doesn't map correctly to SOF's AUX ports. Our HDA test worked because FL/FR positions matched the analog stereo ports, but SOF might use AUX0/AUX1 instead.

Also, SOF on 6.8 kernel + PW 0.3.

不是声卡坏了。他自己的对照已经说明：**麦克风有声，`pw-record` 能录到 −8 dB。** 空的是 **vinput 那条采集流**。

两边要的都是 16kHz、1 声道。差在有没有标明「这 1 路是 MONO」：

- `pw-record --channels 1`：内部 `channelmap_default(1)` → **`SPA_AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO`**
- 当时的 vinput：`channels=1`，`position[0]` 没写，就是 **UNKNOWN**

WirePlumber 0.4.8 要把立体声硬件混成单声道，得知道你要的是 MONO。UNKNOWN 时，有的卡它会瞎混过来，有的卡格式谈成了、端口却没接上，于是日志里有 `negotiated format`，采样是空的。

我们这台 ThinkPad 是普通 **HDA 模拟立体声 `[FL, FR]`**。同一套 0.3.48 + 0.4.8 下，UNKNOWN 也能录到。  
他的节点是 **`skl_hda_dsp_6__source`（Intel SOF DSP）**，不是两个孔 FL/FR，而是 DSP 前端，端口更多、布局更怪。WP 0.4.8 对这种节点 + 1ch UNKNOWN，就可能出现「谈成功、没数据」；`pw-record` 写了 MONO，就能对上。

所以：**不是 SOF 没声，是当时 vinput 的 1ch 流在这块 SOF 上没接到有效采样。**  
普通 HDA 上 UNKNOWN 也能过，所以不能 100% 钉死「所有立体声都会挂」，只能说这是目前和 `pw-record` 对得上的差别，也是 2.3.19 改的那一行。要确认是不是他的根因，还得看他装 2.3.19 之后有没有数据。

Hi @changer-changer,

Thank you so much for the detailed report and the control experiment!

We investigated the issue under Ubuntu 22.04 (PipeWire 0.3.48 + WirePlumber 0.4.8):
1. **Root Cause**: `fcitx5-vinput` previously requested a 1-channel capture stream without specifying the channel position (`raw_info.position[0]` was uninitialized as `0` / `SPA_AUDIO_CHANNEL_UNKNOWN`, and `flags` lacked `SPA_AUDIO_FLAG_UNPOSITIONED`). On WirePlumber 0.4.8, when linking an ALSA hardware capture node with stereo channels (`[FL, FR]`) to an input stream with `UNKNOWN` channel position, WirePlumber's `si-standard-link` policy fails to find a channel mapping rule and silently refuses to establish the port links. Consequently, format negotiation succeeded (`rate=16000 channels=1 fmt=259`), but no audio data was ever routed into the stream.
2. **Fix**: In PR #170, we explicitly set `raw_info.position[0] = SPA_AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO` (following standard PipeWire `pw-cat` / `pw-record` conventions) and added `state_changed` listener callbacks to surface stream state transitions in the daemon log.

A test pre-release is now available: **[v2.3.19 (Pre-release)](https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput/releases/tag/v2.3.19)**.

Could you please test by updating to `fcitx5-vinput_2.3.19-1_debian12_amd64.deb` on your Ubuntu 22.04 system to see if recording now captures audio properly?

Looking forward to your feedback!
--

---README head---
# voice-ptyd

**Global push-to-talk voice input for Linux.** Hold a key, speak, release — transcribed
text (with punctuation) is pasted at your cursor, in any app. Fully offline.

按住快捷键说话，松开即把带标点的识别结果粘贴到光标处。完全离线。[中文说明](#中文)

```
hold F9 ●─────────────── speak 🎙 ─────────────── release ○
   record (pw-record) → transcribe (sherpa-onnx, ~0.15 s)
   → clipboard → Ctrl+V injected at cursor → notification 🔔
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Engines | X-ASR zh+en transducer (**built-in punctuation**, int8, ~136 MB) · SenseVoice int8 (zh/en/ja/ko/yue) + CT-Transformer punct |
| Latency | ~0.1–0.3 s transcription for a sentence (CPU, 8 threads; no GPU needed) |
| Display server | Wayland (GNOME/KDE/Hyprland/Sway) **and** X11 |
| Audio | PipeWire (`pw-record`/`pw-play`) |
| Injection | ydotool ≥ 1.0 via persistent `ydotoold` (uinput) — no per-app plugins |
| Privacy | 100% local. No cloud, no network after model download. |
| Trigger | evdev hotkey listener (hold = record) + optional Ctrl+Alt+V toggle fallback |

## Why this exists

On Ubuntu 22.04 + GNOME Wayland + fcitx5 there was **no working open-source voice input**:

- [fcitx5-vinput](https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput) — great project, but its
  capture silently returns nothing on PipeWire **0.3.48** (the 22.04 default). It works
  on 24.04+; use it there.
- SenseVoice GUI tools — X11 only. IBus-based tools — broken with fcitx5. Cloud-based
  tools (unhush/whisrs/Bolo) — need API keys.

voice-ptyd fills that gap with a boring, auditable ~300-line Python daemon:

```
evdev (all keyboards, hotplug rescan)          ← hold-to-talk trigger
   ↓
pw-record 16 kHz mono  →  energy trim  →  sherpa-onnx offline ASR
   ↓
wl-copy (+ xclip fallback)  →  ydotool key combo (Ctrl+V / Shift+Ins)
   ↓
notify-send + ding/dong + history.jsonl
```

The udev rule ships a `uaccess` tag so the **active seat user** can read keyboard
events (same mechanism as YubiKeys) — no root daemon, no `input` group, no re-login.

## Requirements

- Linux with systemd user sessions; apt-based distro for `install.sh` (tested: Ubuntu 22.04)
- PipeWire audio (installer offers to switch from PulseAudio — that switch is required on 22.04)
- A microphone 🙂

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/changer-changer/voice-ptyd
cd voice-ptyd
./install.sh          # sudo for apt/udev steps; everything else per-user
```

Then **hold F9 and speak**. Fallback toggle: `Ctrl+Alt+V`.

Uninstall: `./uninstall.sh` (add `--full` to also remove ydotoold + udev rule).

## Configuration — `config.json`

```jsonc
{
  "key_code": 67,          // KEY_F9; KEY_F10=68, KEY_RIGHTALT=100, … (linux/input-event-codes.h)
  "key_name": "F9",
  "engine": "xasr",        // "xasr" (zh-en, built-in punct) | "sensevoice" (5-lang)
  "paste_mode": "ctrlv",   // "shiftins" for terminals | "clipboard" (copy only)
  "max_seconds": 90,
  "min_audio_seconds": 0.35,
  "notify": true,
  "ding": true,            // start/stop chime
  "language": "auto"       // sensevoice engine
}

问得好，我上一轮把一个细节说重了，得纠正：

## 1. "站着一秒"是我测试程序加的，真实代码没那么长

我的 capture.c 为了模拟"先占后录"，在 connect 之后 **sleep(1)** 再激活——这是**夸大的模拟**，方便观察状态。

真实 vinput 2.3.15 的代码是（`BeginRecording`）：
```cpp
CreateStream(true)          // 挂 INACTIVE 标志连接
...
SetStreamActive(true, ...)  // 紧接着立刻激活，中间没有任何 sleep
```
间隔只有**几毫秒**。所以真实软件里不存在"占着一秒不录"。

真正和 pw-record 不一样的是**整个生命周期**：

| | pw-record | vinput |
|---|---|---|
| 每次录音 | 新建流→直接激活→录完退出 | 按键按下→`set_active(true)`，松开→`set_active(false)`，**流留着不销毁**（15 秒没再按才销毁） |
| 下次按键 | 重新走一遍建流 | 直接把停着的流再激活 |

## 2. 为什么这么写（不是不如 pw-record，是用途不同）

pw-record 是**一次性命令行工具**：录一个文件就退出，不存在"快速连按"问题。

vinput 是**按住说话**：你按 F8 → 说话 → 松开 → 3 秒后又按。如果每次按键都销毁重建流，每次都要重新走"连接 + 协商格式"（日志里 `create_stream_ms` 就是量这个的），快连按时会卡顿甚至丢第一个字。所以代码加了**流复用**：录完只暂停（deactivate）不销毁，下次直接激活，省掉重建开销。

这个复用是后来加的优化，而且留了后门：设环境变量 **`VINPUT_CAPTURE_REUSE=0`** 就退回"每次按键销毁重建"的旧行为——那反而更接近 pw-record。

## 3. 这对我们意味着什么

如果他那块 SOF 声卡上问题出在"复用流的 activate/deactivate"（而不是声道没写 MONO），那 2.3.19 也救不了——因为 2.3.19 没改生命周期，只改了声道声明。

好消息是诊断不用编译：让他在 daemon 前加 `VINPUT_CAPTURE_REUSE=0` 再按 F8 试一次，如果这样就能录到，就说明是复用流的锅，我们再改代码。这个比让他跑 4 组合矩阵还省事——我先去把这条补到 issue 评论里。

You can force the legacy per-recording destroy/create (closest to pw-record behaviour) with an env var — no rebuild, no deb:

```bash
systemctl --user stop fcitx5-vinput   # or however the daemon runs
VINPUT_CAPTURE_REUSE=0 fcitx5-vinput  # run in foreground; press F8 and speak
